description:
[Game reference] Every fish and junk catch, where it bites, and bait values. From the game's server files (the data on rust.wiki/fishing): `fish` (`name`, `shortname`, `where` it bites -
river, ocean, swamp, deep sea, moon pool - `min_bait`/`max_bait` bait points, `min_depth_m`/`max_depth_m`,
relative `chance`, `fight` strength, `junk`, `mountable` on a trophy), `bait` (bait points each item is worth)
and `rules` (how bait, depth and location combine). Vanilla values.

item.description: Only one catch or bait, by shortname or name.
